title: Cheese spread, American or Cheddar cheese base, reduced fat

content.title: About
content.content: Cheese spread made from American or Cheddar cheese with reduced fat is a smooth, easily spreadable paste with a characteristic creamy flavor. It contains less fat than traditional cheese spreads while retaining a rich cheese taste.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Cheese spread is often used as a base for sandwiches, appetizers, and sauces.
Reduced fat is achieved by partially replacing butter with low‑fat dairy ingredients.
American and Cheddar cheeses have a milder flavor compared to many European cheeses, making the spread versatile.
The product is frequently fortified with calcium and vitamin D to support bone health.
Cheese spread can be used to create creamy sauces without adding extra fat.

items.title: Rich in calcium
items.content: Cheese spread provides a notable amount of calcium, essential for strong bones and teeth.

items.title: Source of protein
items.content: The cheese base supplies high‑quality protein needed for tissue repair.

items.title: Reduced fat content
items.content: Compared with regular spreads, the lower fat level makes it more suitable for calorie‑controlled diets.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: Contains vitamins B2 and B12, which support energy metabolism.

items.title: Probiotics (when added)
items.content: Some versions are enriched with probiotic cultures that help maintain gut flora.

items.title: Milk protein allergy
items.content: People allergic to dairy proteins or lactose may experience reactions.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: Certain varieties may contain higher salt levels, which should be considered by those with hypertension.

items.title: Preservatives
items.content: To extend shelf life, preservatives may be added, which some consumers prefer to avoid.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Spread cheese spread on bread, crackers, vegetable sticks, use as a filling for rolls, in pasta sauces, or in casseroles. It can be mixed with herbs, spices, or yogurt to create new flavor profiles.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in the refrigerator at 2 °C–6 °C in the original packaging. After opening, consume within 7‑10 days. Discard if you notice off‑odors, color changes, or mold.
